task_definition.task_description: Please check the current time in New York, then see whether the NASDAQ market is open, get the current BTC price, and after that look up the USD to JPY exchange rate. Then create a medium-priority app trip summary for user_001’s checking account in JPY, and save a note titled “Trip Summary” with the balance details converted to JPY.
